about: Names given by hand in the ninth session's commits that are not in another names file: six functions that a comma sequence with temporaries became again (the temporaries are their parameters), and nine numbers that stood bare in more than one place. Each with its evidence, or the word inferred.

sol-heredit/actors.js.getHealingTotemFormulaStats: its value is the formulaStats of the kind "healing_totem"; it reads getMonsterFormulaStats(healingTotemNpcTypeId) into the temporary that was called totemStats

sol-heredit/minions.js.applyRelentlessToPlan: its parameters are the temporaries basePlan and relentlessTier; applyRelentlessDefenceBypass(player, relentlessTier) stands beside it, whole; 'ToPlan' is inferred

sol-heredit/constants.js.grappleWindowTicks: grapple.js: resolveTick = pending.startTick + 4, and a click counts from startTick to startTick + 4; the snapshot's grapple.resolveTick is the same sum; 'window' is inferred

sol-heredit/lightBeams.js.beamPrepareLeadTicks: LightBeamRuntime.prepare sets chargeTick: tick + 3 and answers 3 + chargeTicks; cancelActiveRound takes the 3 off again; 'lead' is inferred

inferno/waves.js.isSpawnLayoutComplete: inferred: the layout's filled slots are as many as the slot NPCs of its wave; its parameter is the temporary spawnLayout

inferno/InfernoEncounter.js.registerWaveMonsters: its parameter is the temporary waveMonsterServices; it returns the results of nibblerNpcDefinition.register(...) to magerNpcDefinition.register(...)
inferno/InfernoEncounter.js.registerWaveNpcs: its parameter is the temporary services; it returns the wave monsters' registrations and those of jadHealerNpcDefinition and jadNpcDefinition; 'Wave' is inferred
inferno/InfernoEncounter.js.registerZukNpcs: its parameters are the temporaries getZukFight and presentParentHeal; it returns the registrations of zukShieldNpcDefinition, zukHealerNpcDefinition and zukNpcDefinition

inferno/zuk.js.zukJadHpThreshold: under it, and while !state.jadSpawned, the definition calls config.spawnJad; ZukFight.syncBossHp sets jadSpawned = bossHp < 480; the hitpoint preset of 480 is labelled "Pre-Jad"
inferno/zuk.js.zukHealersHpThreshold: under it, and while !state.healersSpawned, the definition calls config.spawnHealers; ZukFight.syncBossHp sets healersSpawned = bossHp < 240
inferno/zuk.js.zukCastIntervalTicks: getZukCastIntervalTicks returns it, or enragedZukCastIntervalTicks, which the bundle left with its name

inferno/zukFight.js.zukOpeningCastDelayTicks: it is passed as openingDelayTicks, and openingCastTick = glyphSpawnTick + openingDelayTicks

yama/constants.js.yamaSize: Yama's actor record and his pursuit options had size: 5, and the attack policy measures the distance to a footprint of 5

yama/fireballGeometry.js.fireballLifetimeTicks: getFireballPhase answers "done" from 5 ticks after the start, and endTick was startTick + 5 - 1 in three places; 'lifetime' is inferred

yama/boss.js.yamaMeleePoisonSeverity: it is the attack's applyPoison, which the engine hands to applyPoisonToPlayer(poisonSeverity)
